summary: Move repository configuration from .st to .fractal, updating the ci-script-tests and genie-freshness lane definition directories to cover .fractal. All other configuration contents are preserved. Readers continue to prefer .fractal and use .st only when the preferred file is absent at the same pinned revision or checkout root.

replay.detail: No graph, replay or runtime state-directory change. Tracked repository configuration moves, with two lane definition-directory entries updated to the new location.

schema.detail: Configuration schemas are unchanged. The only configuration-content changes are the ci-script-tests and genie-freshness definition_paths directory entries from .st to .fractal.

compatibility.detail: The existing absence-only .st fallback remains; malformed or unreadable .fractal configuration does not fall back. Pinned readers select configuration from that same revision, never another revision. No CLI, API or wire change.

downtime.detail: No service restart or host mutation is required.

manual.detail: Do not ready or merge this Q27 PR3 move before 2026-11-01. Retain the legacy fallback until Q27 PR4, at least seven days after the move and no earlier than 2026-11-08.

recovery.detail: Revert the config-file move; retained readers still accept the legacy layout.
